summary.headline: Jupiter, Mars, and Venus
summary.text: Astrological significations of Jupiter, Mars, and Venus, including their effects on social affairs, occupations, bodily parts, substances, sect, colors, and tastes. Jupiter governs prosperity, justice, inheritances, and tin; Mars governs violence, warfare, bloodshed, iron, and Aries; Venus governs love, priesthoods, beauty, music, painting, perfumery, emerald, ivory, and goldworking.
